device.description: 8-bit 1 MSPS 8-channel SAR ADC with SPI interface, auto/manual channel sequencing, GPIOs and alarms
device.note: ads7950.pdf (SLAS605C) p.6-9 pin functions, p.10 recommended operating conditions, p.17-19 timing (Figures 1-4), p.28 overview, p.29-41 channel sequencing and mode control (Tables 1-7), p.41-42 output codes (Tables 8-10), p.43 GPIO program register (Table 11), p.43-45 alarm thresholds (Tables 12-13)

pages: p.6-9 (pin functions), p.10 (ROC: +VBD 1.7 V to +VA, +VA max 5.25 V), p.17 (timing requirements, 1.8 V column: td1 38, td2 35, td4 24 ns; tconv 16 SCLK), p.18-19 (Figures 2-4 frame: DO15-12 channel address, MSB on 4th SCLK fall, SDO 3-state at 16th fall; SDI latched on SCLK rise), p.28 (operation), p.33 (Table 1 manual), p.36 (Table 2 Auto-1), p.37 (Tables 3-4 Auto-1 program), p.39 (Table 5 Auto-2), p.41 (Tables 6-8), p.42 (Tables 9-10 straight binary), p.43 (Table 11 GPIO), p.45 (Table 13 alarms)
notModeled: analog multiplexer, MXO/AINP breakout, input ranges (CTRL.RANGE stored only; both ranges are unipolar, 0 V = code 0)
pipeline latency: a manual-mode channel written in frame n is converted at the start of frame n+2 (modeled: frame n+1); [CH] shows the channel selected when the conversion starts

Auto-1 / Auto-2 channel sequencing: the channel counter never advances (modeled: entering or continuing an auto mode selects channel 0, which is the first channel of the reset Auto-1 sequence and of every Auto-2 sequence); AUTO1/AUTO2 are stored only
alarm comparison and the GPIO0/GPIO1 alarm outputs (ALARM_Hn/ALARM_Ln are written through the 11bb sequence and stored only; the 0 V code never trips the reset thresholds 3FFh/000h)
GPIO pins: GPO data (CTRL.GPO) is never driven onto GPIO0-3 and GPI levels are not read; with DI04=1 DO15-12 shift the stored GPO bits (CTRL.GPO) in place of the GPIO pin levels
GPIO2 as range input and GPIO3 as asynchronous active-low power-down input (GPIO_CFG.RANGE_EN / PD_EN stored only)
power-down via DI05=1 takes effect at the 16th SCLK of the next frame (modeled: at the end of the frame that writes it); wake-up on the CS fall with DI05=0 is modeled as the end of that frame
DI09=1 GPIO-program reset happens in the next CS frame (modeled: at the end of the writing frame)
first frame after power-up outputs invalid SDO (modeled: channel 0 / 0 V code)
trailing bits after the LSB for 10-bit (DO1-0) and 8-bit (DO3-0) devices are not specified; modeled as 0
SCLK frequency (20 MHz max) and quiet time tq
variants: One datasheet (ads7950.pdf, SLAS605C) covers ADS7950/51/52/53 (12-bit, 4/8/12/16 ch), ADS7954/55/56/57 (10-bit) and ADS7958/59/60/61 (8-bit). 4/8-channel parts: TSSOP-30 (DBT) / VQFN-24 (RGE); 12/16-channel parts: TSSOP-38 (DBT) / VQFN-32 (RHB). VQFN packages bring out GPIO0 only. The -Q1 parts (ads7956-q1.pdf, ads7955-q1.pdf) are the same chips in DBT only.
